I need to make a legal Monopoly move. The previous trade was invalid because it involved properties with buildings.

I have $732 and am on B_O_RAILROAD. My properties are mostly mortgaged, though I have three houses on St Charles Place and States Avenue, and four houses on Virginia, St James Place, Tennessee Avenue, and New York Avenue. The bank has no houses left but still has twelve hotels.

I cannot build houses because the bank has none left. Hoteling my orange properties would return four houses to the bank, which I should avoid since p2 could buy them back.

p2 has $395 and owns reds with three to four houses each. p4 has only $86 and is mostly mortgaged but recently paid me $750 in rent.

Unmortgaging the light blue properties would cost $154 total, but that still leaves me unable to build houses because the bank has none left. Hoteling my orange properties is not a viable option either.

Unmortgaging the light blues would yield only a few dollars in rent, so it is not worthwhile. My $732 cash buffer can cover p2's red rents of $700 each, but not the $1100 on Illinois. I will keep the properties mortgaged to preserve that buffer.

Mortgaged properties are not worth trading away. The dark blue monopoly is split between p2 and p4, but neither has cash to build on it. I will avoid trading my houses or get-out-of-jail-free cards.

I will end my turn. Completing railroads or acquiring Mediterranean and Marvin Gardens would not help me build houses, since those properties currently have no houses on them.
